entries.reason: a call directory is an application extension, and iOS 6 loads none (facts/Foundation/CloudAndExtensions.md: no host, NSExtensionMain answers 69), so no identifier names one; the class is there, and refuses at that seam
entries.effect: +sharedInstance is one manager; -reloadExtensionWithIdentifier:completionHandler: completes with CXErrorDomainCallDirectoryManager / CXErrorCodeCallDirectoryManagerErrorNoExtensionFound, and -getEnabledStatusForExtensionWithIdentifier:completionHandler: with CXCallDirectoryEnabledStatusUnknown and the same error, each on a global queue, as an identifier with no extension is answered
entries.source: SDK 16.4, CallKit, for the errors; the host's CallKit under Mac Catalyst (tests/backports/host/callkit/run.sh) for the queue and the shared instance

entries.reason: the header gives the method to a Notification Service Extension, to have its application launched for a VoIP call; iOS 6 has no application extensions, so no caller is ever one, and apsd of 6.1.3 delivers no VoIP push to report (facts/PushKit/PushKit.md)
entries.effect: calls the completion once, before returning, on the caller's thread, with CXErrorDomainNotificationServiceExtension / CXErrorCodeNotificationServiceExtensionErrorMissingNotificationFilteringEntitlement and no user info, the host's answer to a process that is no extension and holds no notification filtering entitlement; a nil completion is allowed
entries.source: the host's CallKit under Mac Catalyst (tests/backports/host/callkit/run.sh), and SDK 16.4, CallKit

entries.reason: iOS 6 has no settings page of call directories to open, and the releases before 13.4 give an application no public way to open theirs
entries.effect: completes on a global queue with NSCocoaErrorDomain / NSFeatureUnsupportedError, the host's answer where it has no such page
entries.source: the host's CallKit under Mac Catalyst (tests/backports/host/callkit/run.sh), and SDK 16.4, CallKit

entries.reason: the principal class of a call directory extension, and iOS 6 loads no extensions (facts/Foundation/CloudAndExtensions.md: no host, NSExtensionMain answers 69), so nothing ever begins a request
entries.effect: -beginRequestWithExtensionContext: of the base class does nothing, as the host's does; a subclass loads and can be made
entries.source: the host's CallKit under Mac Catalyst (tests/backports/host/callkit/run.sh), and SDK 16.4, CallKit

entries.reason: the context the system hands a call directory extension, and iOS 6 runs none (facts/Foundation/CloudAndExtensions.md), so a context has no host to take its entries
entries.effect: an NSExtensionContext whose entries go nowhere: it is not incremental, has no delegate and no input items, the adding methods return, the four removing ones raise NSInternalInconsistencyException with the host's text, since a context that is not incremental takes no removals, and -completeRequestWithCompletionHandler: is never answered, as the host's context with no host is not
